title: Passes
description: Tokyo Tower seen from the street between two building faces, and a sun you can move. Drag and the sun swings around the canyon: across is where it stands, from behind your left shoulder through straight ahead, behind the tower, to behind your right; up and down is how high. The concrete and the tower's lattice take its warm light from the surface normals a renderer would keep, the faces turned away fall into the sky's cyan, and when the sun stands in the frame the sky warms around it.
intent: Reality pieces: the layers under a captured image, after Unreal's buffer visualization (https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/viewport-modes-in-unreal-engine), photogrammetry tools like Polycam and RealityScan, and Thomas Ruff's jpegs, where the image's structure becomes the image. Photo by Jakob Owens on Unsplash. Depth by Depth Anything V2, normals by MoGe-2, mattes by SAM 2.1, baked offline.
